heading: Delicious Dining
body: With The Ylang Ylang's secluded location, the villa's chef is pivotal to guest enjoyment. The resident chef produces gourmet local specialties, Asian, European and fusion dishes at a fine-dining level. Mealtimes are an occasion — from poolside barbecues to three-course formal dinners at an exquisitely-set table, across the villa's multiple dining areas. Emphasis is on delicious, freshly-made and healthy food, with special diets accommodated such as Detox and South Beach. Beverages are discerning: three coffee makers, 40 varieties of tea, a superb selection of fine wines and cosmopolitan cocktails.
menus: Extensive suggestion menus are available including vegetarian and children's; the chef and assistant are flexible for alternatives. Guests are requested to order at least one day in advance. The villa cannot operate as a restaurant taking individual orders per guest — groups are asked to select the same or shared dishes.
provisioning: Groceries and beverages are charged at cost price plus a 20%++ handling fee (subject to service and tax). Guests provide cash in advance; staff purchase and keep receipts, tallied at the end of the stay (checkable day-to-day).
